title: Orchestrator Config Schema
description: Configuration schema for the orchestrator dispatch + gate engine. Every path is configurable, every count is a list length, every role is a string.

shared_roots.description: Shared root paths for orchestrator and agents (primary/fallback resolution)

orchestrator_fallback.description: Fallback orchestrator root if primary unavailable (e.g., 'D:/IA/orchestrator')

agents_fallback.description: Fallback agents profiles root if primary unavailable (e.g., 'D:/IA/agents')

paths.description: All file and folder paths (engine-private and agent-facing). Engine code references logical names only; layout is a config decision.

state_root.description: Engine-private root folder (agent-prohibited). Contains staged data, full plan, etc. (e.g., '.orchestrator')

dispatch_root.description: Agent-facing root folder. Contains per-agent inbox/outbox/reports/done/archive (e.g., 'dispatch')

trackers.description: Watcher fan-in state for restart recovery (engine-private). (e.g., '.orchestrator/trackers.json')

diffs.description: Staged diffs for review, keyed by task_id (engine-private). (e.g., '.orchestrator/diffs')

merged_verdicts.description: Watcher output, commit-gate input. Merged verdicts per task (engine-private). (e.g., '.orchestrator/merged_verdicts')

halts.description: Monitor halt signal flags or messages (engine-private). (e.g., '.orchestrator/halts')

approvals_source.description: Where verdict files are written and read by watcher. 'outbox' = dispatch/<agent>/outbox. (e.g., 'outbox')

halt_mode.description: How monitor halts coder: 'flag_file' (synchronous flag file, default), 'inbox_inject' (message in inbox, async)

playwright_tests.description: Path to Playwright E2E test files run after coder delivers. (e.g., 'tests/e2e')

mechanism.description: Multiplexer backend for agent wake. 'tmux' for Linux/macOS, 'psmux' for Windows PowerShell. Configurable for future backends.

first_attempt_seconds.description: Initial wait before first wake attempt (seconds)

max_retries.description: Maximum number of wake retry attempts

monitor_pulse_seconds.description: Interval at which monitor agent is woken to check coder's live tool-call stream (seconds)

idle_threshold_seconds.description: Agent is considered idle if no tool use for this duration. Liveness ticker re-wakes idle agents (seconds)

liveness_check_interval_seconds.description: Interval at which liveness ticker checks for idle agents and re-wakes them (seconds). Runs on separate thread to not block main watcher loop.

require_ready_files.description: If true, agents must create dispatch/<self>/ready before dispatch begins

halt_between_batches.description: If true, watcher halts between task batches waiting for manual confirmation

session_prefix.description: Prefix prepended to agent name when forming tmux/psmux session name (e.g., 'gate-ralph')

monitor_activity_to_dispatch.description: Legacy activity_logger fallback: if true, ship coder tool calls to monitor via send.py. Superseded by monitor_ingest.py PostToolUse hook.

agents.description: Agent roster. N coders, M monitors, P reviewers — all from config. Engine works with any mix. No hardcoded agent names.

profile.description: Agent profile reference (e.g., 'gate-ralph', 'gate-architect'). Resolved from shared_roots.agents_*.

executor.description: If true, agent is a code executor and gets commit-gate, dispatch-gate hooks. If false, reviewer or monitor.

roles.description: Agent roles. 'coder' = dispatch-gate + monitor ingest. 'monitor' + 'playwright' = live monitoring + E2E testing. 'reviewer' = verdict writer. One agent can have multiple roles.

routing.description: Message routing rules for dispatch contract

cc_all.description: Agents to receive copies of all outbox messages (e.g., ['monitor'])

review_requests_to.description: Agents to receive review requests when coder delivers. Length determines N reviewers. (e.g., ['architect', 'critic'])

on_batch_complete.description: Agents notified when a task batch completes (e.g., ['playwright'])

on_stop.description: Agents notified on agent stop event (e.g., ['architect', 'critic', 'monitor'])

require_approvals_from.description: Agents whose approval is required for commit. Should match review_requests_to. (e.g., ['architect', 'critic'])

consensus_rule.description: How to merge reviewer verdicts. 'unanimous' = all required must approve. 'majority' = >50%. 'any_pass' = at least one (not recommended).

max_rework_rounds.description: Maximum number of rework cycles before escalation to Allan

protected_branches.description: Branches where commit-gate fires. Commits to other branches are ungated. (e.g., ['dev', 'main'])

required.description: Agents whose verdict is required before consensus. (e.g., ['architect', 'critic'])

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum wait for all required verdicts before timeout escalation (seconds)

on_timeout.description: Action on verdict timeout. 'escalate_allan' drops escalation message in dispatch/allan/inbox/.
